record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: KRABBY (1 star) and KINGLER (2 stars), the queued units.
record.summary: Mutual lock plus special damage plus a temporary copy of the target's defenses. In order: (1) target.status.triggerLocked(4000, target); (2) caster.status.triggerLocked(4000, caster); (3) target.handleSpecialDamage(damage, SPECIAL, caster, crit) with damage 30 (KRABBY, 1 star) or 60 (KINGLER, 2 stars) as the REQUESTED amount; (4) the caster gains the target's current DEF and SPE_DEF via addDefense / addSpecialDefense (apBoost 1, crit flag passed) and (5) a DelayedCommand 4000 ms later on the caster's own command list calls the same adders with the negated raw gains. Each lock is requested independently and refused by its own guards (already locked, skydiving, Rune Protect, IMMUNITY_LOCKED, ccCooldown > 0); enraged halves the duration, then SWIFT_SWIM / HYDRATION / WATER_VEIL / SURGE_SURFER and ODD_KEYSTONE reductions apply, the result is rounded, and the unit's range is set to 1. A locked unit cannot move or be moved (canMove / canBeMoved) but can still attack. The stat gain and its revert happen whether or not either lock took effect. The damage is intermediate: AP and crit multiply it, handleDamage divides by the special-defense factor (minimum 1), shields and later modifiers follow; takenDamage (shield damage included) is unused. No heal, PP gain or shield is requested (Rune Protect and Protect are irrelevant to the stat gain; Protect on the target blocks the damage).

targeting.who: the cast target (lock + damage + source of the copied DEF / SPE_DEF) and the caster itself (lock + the gained stats)

effects.scaling: requested amount: handleSpecialDamage applies AP (x (1 + AP/100), apBoost default true) and the cast's crit flag (needs ABILITY_CRIT; canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: intermediate, not guaranteed final HP loss: handleDamage divides by the special-defense factor (ceil, minimum 1), then shields, items and later modifiers follow; blocked by protect / skydiving / magicBounce on the target. Requested after both lock requests and before the stat gain, so the copied DEF / SPE_DEF are read after the damage call (the damage does not change them). The requested amount (30 / 60), the AP-and-crit amount handed to handleDamage and the takenDamage (shield damage included) are three different numbers; the return value is unused (no heal, no kill effect).

effects.direction: gain, then equal-sized revert after 4000 ms (recomputed)

declaredRaw.formula: target.def x 1 (read after the damage request)
declaredRaw.note: no fixed number: depends on the target's DEF at cast time; revert delay 4000 ms

effects.scaling: addDefense with apBoost 1: Math.round(value x (1 + AP/100) x (crit ? critPower : 1)); the revert call uses the AP at revert time
effects.resolution: Requested: the caster's gain equals the target's CURRENT DEF read once, after the damage request, at cast time (raw, labelled defGain / spedefGain). Applied at cast: addX rounds value x (1 + AP/100) x (crit ? critPower : 1) (apBoost 1), then the caster's Big Eater Belt multiplies a positive value by 1.25 rounded down, then Twist Band (only negative values from an opposing caster; none here), then def = max(0, def + value). The revert 4000 ms later is a separate call with the NEGATED raw gain: it is recomputed with the caster's AP at that time and the same crit flag, a Big Eater Belt on the caster scales this negative self-inflicted change too (x1.25, rounded down, i.e. further from zero) so the loss can exceed the gain, Twist Band does not flip it (caster and holder are the same team), and the floor of 0 applies. The change is therefore not guaranteed to cancel exactly.

statusEffects.target: the cast target and, separately, the caster
statusEffects.scaling: none from AP or crit (no apBoost parameter)
statusEffects.applicationOrder: target first, then caster, both before the damage
statusEffects.guards: each request is refused (no change at all, including no range change) when that unit is already locked (no stacking), skydiving, has runeProtect or IMMUNITY_LOCKED, or has ccCooldown > 0 (set after a previous lock ends); otherwise enraged halves the duration, then applyStatusDurationReductions (SWIFT_SWIM x0.7, else HYDRATION x0.5, else WATER_VEIL / SURGE_SURFER x0.3, then -10% per ODD_KEYSTONE) and Math.round; the unit's range is set to 1 (a unit with another range is first forced back to the moving state). The two requests do not depend on each other; each reads its own unit's effects, items and player.
statusEffects.combatEffect: canMove and canBeMoved are false while locked (no walking, no forced displacement). canAttack and canCast do not check locked. When the timer runs out updateLocked restores the base range (plus Wide Lens / Long Wand adjustments) and sets a ccCooldown that blocks relocking for a while (CC_COOLDOWN value not read).

buffs.duration: 4000 ms via DelayedCommand (not a status timer)

starBehavior.note: damage indexed by the caster's stars (pokemon.stars - 1), fallback 200; 100 and 200 are not reached by these units. Lock duration, stat-copy factor (x1) and revert delay do not depend on stars. maxPP 100 and range 1 for both.

record.positionalConditions: None in the strategy; the target is whatever the generic cast supplies.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: Casts do not stack their locks (a still-locked unit refuses a new lock) but their stat gains do: each cast reads the target's DEF / SPE_DEF at that time and schedules its own revert 4000 ms later, so overlapping casts overlap their gains. No modes.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: damage 30 / 60; locks of 4000 ms on target and caster; caster gain = target DEF and SPE_DEF (x1) and an equal negated request after 4000 ms. Applied: damage after AP, crit, special-defense division (min 1), shields; lock duration after enrage halving, reductions and rounding, only if that unit's guards pass; stat gains after AP/crit rounding, Big Eater Belt (x1.25 down, also on the negative revert because the caster is its own team) and the floor of 0; the revert is recomputed at revert time so a changed AP or a Big Eater Belt can make it differ from the original gain. Twist Band never flips either direction here (positive gain; revert from the same team).
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (shields, items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection) - only the SPECIAL speDef division and the minimum of 1 were read
